bdems_mapping.Access: TxC + TxD the first time an agency needs the item, none after (its key was released)
bdems_mapping.Collect: TxA (Sender + Provider or Sender + Court, ecrecover-checked) and TxB (Court)
bdems_mapping.Dispose: TxE, then the destruction confirmation once TxE is included
bdems_mapping.Transfer: release: TxC by the receiving agency; receipt: TxD by the registering Sender
bdems_mapping.direction: events with no transaction favour B-DEMS (fewer transactions than LEChain's one per event); two transactions for COLLECT, a first access and DISPOSE count against it; both are its paper's workflow

bdems_runs.collection_method: voluntary for an even capsule index (TxA and TxD signed by Sender and Provider), compulsory for an odd one (TxA by Sender and Court, TxD by the Sender)

method.commit_time: first observation of the including block by a watcher polling every 20 ms
method.gas_limit: eth_estimateGas x 1.25 per call type, as web3.py (LEChain's client) estimates
method.ours_anchoring: an AIS worker thread with its own account signs (ML-DSA-65 + SLH-DSA co-signature) and submits each closed epoch while ingest continues
method.ours_event_time: when the record is signed, indexed and in the epoch tree; our client-side signing is before it, as LEChain's pre-signing is before its submission
method.rates: not computed here; mkfigs divides events by the recorded span
method.same_stream: per axis point (M13 A4): each ours row names lechain_stream_capsules and lechain_same_stream; a point whose stream exceeds 10^4 capsules is compared with the 10^4-capsule run, LEChain's steady state

order_gas_by_k.config: D4: the order's 0x05 leaf digest recorded on chain; sigma_CO verified by the AIS and auditors

ours.anchor_is: commitRoot(cid, R_e, d_prev, d_e, A_e): no signature and no leaf count on chain (D4 + M13 A21); n_e is committed in d_e and the approval set travels off chain
ours.anchor_mldsa_sign_is: the M custodian approvals of d_e, together
ours.custody_keywords_are: {eid_e, evt, actor:⟪id, role⟫, role} ∪ anc(ts): draft8 Phase 6 Step 4, emitted from the library's own constant (M13 A2)
ours.orders_are: one FULL/ERASED sweep order per epoch that disposes anything; its 0x05 digest recorded by orderRedaction before that epoch's anchor (§1v.4, D4)
ours.total_leaves_is: the case's leaves summed across epochs, reported here and anchored nowhere: since M13 A21 the chain carries no count, cumulative or otherwise
